scope: Both ordinary and fleet CLI requested-module preflight plus atomic service requested-module failure. Shared CLI wrapper preserves interactive selection policy, original BadParameter and exit2.

verification.environment: PYTHONPATH absoluteworkspace/src; pytest -o pythonpath same; .venv Python3.13

assertions: Single and two-repository CLI preserve prior verified current generation
Generic persisted diagnostic excludes sentinel exception details
Safe/writable atomic output only, direct-generation suppresses all diagnostic writes
Unwritable diagnostic storage preserves original CLI error
Service validated/provided or generated identity, traversal rejected
No invented scan timestamp before analysis
limitations: Other CLI argument/parser failures outside modulepreflight not expanded
